data.name: Retha
data.gender_notes: Retha is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Retha was a goddess of fertility and healing. In Christianity, Retha is a rare name associated with the biblical figure Ruth, who showed great loyalty and faithfulness to her mother-in-law Naomi. Retha means 'delight' or 'comfort' and symbolizes peace, kindness, and loyalty. The name Retha carries the meaning “Delight, Comfort, Peace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Retha usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, comfort, peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spiritual traits of kindness, faithfulness, and loyalty.
data.etymology: Retha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Comfort, Peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Retha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Although Retha is a rare Christian name, it carries the legacy of the ancient Greek goddess Retha, who was regarded as the goddess of fertility and healing. This historical connection provides a unique and intriguing cultural dimension to the name. Additionally, due to its rarity, Retha may be seen as an unique and distinctive name, setting its bearer apart from others.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Retha holds significant spiritual meaning for Christians, as it is derived from the biblical character Ruth. Ruth was a widow who demonstrated unwavering loyalty and faithfulness to her mother-in-law Naomi, ultimately leading to her marriage to Boaz and the founding of the royal line of King David. Retha, meaning 'delight' or 'comfort,' symbolizes the peace, kindness, and loyalty that defined Ruth's character and the genuine affection shared between the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law. As a result, the name Retha can be seen as a powerful reminder of the importance of loyalty, kindness, and love within familial relationships.
